# Warm Burnout

Warm Burnout is a dark and light theme that removes blue chrome in favour of amber-to-stone tones. Headings use amber-to-warm-stone gradients, twelve distinct warm callout styles are provided, syntax highlighting covers both editor and preview, and graph and canvas accents follow the same warm range. Its recorded description states that the contrast was audited.

![Warm Burnout screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/felipefdl/warm-burnout-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Warm Burnout"
    author: "felipefdl"

    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/felipefdl/warm-burnout-obsidian/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a warm, contrast-audited dark and light Obsidian theme that removes blue chrome and favors amber-to-stone tones. Use amber-to-warm-stone heading gradients, 12 distinct warm callout styles, full editor+preview syntax highlighting, and warm graph/canvas accents for readable structure."
}
```
